definitions.gloss: to fall completely silent; to become dead quiet
definitions.explanation: Describes a place or group of people becoming utterly still and silent. Stronger and more emphatic than 静まる alone.

examples.japanese: {教室|きょうしつ}が{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}った。
{深夜|しんや}の{住宅街|じゅうたくがい}は{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}っていた。
examples.english: The residential neighborhood was dead quiet late at night.

examples.japanese: {校長|こうちょう}{先生|せんせい}が{壇上|だんじょう}に{立|た}つと、{体育館|たいいくかん}は{一瞬|いっしゅん}で{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}った。
examples.english: The moment the principal took the stage, the gymnasium fell instantly silent.

notes:
{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}る is an intransitive godan verb. It is a compound of {静|しず}まる (to become quiet) and {返|かえ}る used as a suffix meaning "thoroughly" or "completely."

ASPECT (ている):
{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}っている describes a state of complete silence already achieved.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教室|きょうしつ}が{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}る (classroom falls silent)
- {会場|かいじょう}が{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}る (venue falls silent)
- {辺|あた}りが{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}る (the surroundings go quiet)

The ～{返|かえ}る suffix intensifies the base verb, similar to how {冷|ひ}え{返|かえ}る means "to become ice cold."
